local WindUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://github.com/Footagesus/WindUI/releases/latest/download/main.lua"))()

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

-- อ้างอิง Remote Events
local GalaxyEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SpawnGalaxyBlock")
local RainbowEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SpawnRainbowBlock")

-- ตัวแปรระบบ Auto Spawn
local autoGalaxy = false
local autoRainbow = false
local spawnDelay = 0.01

-- สร้าง Window
local Window = WindUI:CreateWindow({
    Title = "Ruok HUB",
    Icon = "https://img1.pic.in.th/images/IMG_20260803_204606_507-Photoroom.png",
    Author = "By ruok989709",
    Folder = "MySuperHub",
    Theme = "Dark",
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(600, 400),
    MinSize = Vector2.new(480, 350),
    MaxSize = Vector2.new(800, 500),
    SideBarWidth = 160,
})

-- ==================== ระบบเปิด/ปิด UI ด้วย RightShift ====================
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
        Window:Toggle()
    end
end)

-- ==================== ฟังก์ชั่นทำสีรุ้ง RichText (สำหรับด้านใน) ====================
local function getRainbowText(text, speed)
    local result = ""
    local t = tick() * (speed or 2)
    for i = 1, #text do
        local char = text:sub(i, i)
        if char == " " then
            result = result .. " "
        else
            local hue = ((t + (i * 0.08)) % 1)
            local color = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)
            result = result .. string.format('<font color="#%s">%s</font>', color:ToHex(), char)
        end
    end
    return result
end

-- ==================== Loop อัปเดตสีรุ้ง (ทั้งนอกและใน UI) ====================
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local t = tick() * 2.5
    local currentHue = (t % 1)
    local rainbowColor = Color3.fromHSV(currentHue, 1, 1)

    -- 1. อัปเดตสีรุ้งข้างใน UI (RichText)
    if Window.SetTitle then Window:SetTitle(getRainbowText("Ruok HUB", 2.5)) end
    if Window.SetAuthor then Window:SetAuthor(getRainbowText("By ruok989709", 2.5)) end

    -- 2. ค้นหา TextLabel ปุ่มนอก UI แล้วเปลี่ยน TextColor3 โดยตรง
    local guiParent = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("WindUI") or Player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if guiParent then
        for _, v in pairs(guiParent:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("TextLabel") and v.Text:find("Ruok HUB") then
                v.TextColor3 = rainbowColor
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- ==================== Auto Spawn Loop ====================
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        if autoGalaxy then
            GalaxyEvent:FireServer()
        end
        if autoRainbow then
            RainbowEvent:FireServer()
        end
        
        if autoGalaxy or autoRainbow then
            task.wait(spawnDelay)
        else
            task.wait(0.2)
        end
    end
end)

-- ==================== Tab หลัก ====================
local MainTab = Window:Tab({Title = "Main", Icon = "rbxassetid://10723415903"})

-- เปิด/ปิด Galaxy Block
MainTab:Toggle({
    Title = "Auto Spawn GalaxyBlock",
    Desc = "เปิดใช้งานเพื่อกดปั๊ม Galaxy Block รัวๆ",
    Value = false,
    Callback = function(State)
        autoGalaxy = State
    end
})

-- เปิด/ปิด Rainbow Block (เพิ่มใหม่)
MainTab:Toggle({
    Title = "Auto Spawn RainbowBlock",
    Desc = "เปิดใช้งานเพื่อกดปั๊ม Rainbow Block รัวๆ",
    Value = false,
    Callback = function(State)
        autoRainbow = State
    end
})

-- ปรับความเร็ว
MainTab:Slider({
    Title = "Spawn Delay (วินาที)",
    Desc = "ปรับความเร็วในการปั๊ม (ยิ่งน้อยยิ่งเร็ว)",
    Step = 0.01,
    Value = {
        Min = 0.01,
        Max = 1,
        Default = 0.01,
    },
    Callback = function(Value)
        spawnDelay = Value
    end
})

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local CustomizeCharacter = ReplicatedStorage
	:WaitForChild("GameShared")
	:WaitForChild("Remotes")
	:WaitForChild("CustomizeCharacter")

local RGBSpeed = 0.35 -- ความเร็วในการวนสี
local Running = false
local Connection
local StartTime = 0

local function StartRGB()
	if Connection then
		Connection:Disconnect()
	end

	Running = true
	StartTime = os.clock()

	Connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not Running then return end

		-- คำนวณ Hue ตามเวลา ทำให้การไล่สีต่อเนื่อง
		local Hue = ((os.clock() - StartTime) * RGBSpeed) % 1
		local Color = Color3.fromHSV(Hue, 1, 1)

		CustomizeCharacter:FireServer({
			R = math.floor(Color.R * 255),
			G = math.floor(Color.G * 255),
			B = math.floor(Color.B * 255)
		})
	end)
end

local function StopRGB()
	Running = false

	if Connection then
		Connection:Disconnect()
		Connection = nil
	end
end

StartRGB()

local function gradient(text, startColor, endColor)
    local result = ""
    for i = 1, #text do
        local t = (i - 1) / (#text - 1)
        local r = math.floor((startColor.R + (endColor.R - startColor.R) * t) * 255)
        local g = math.floor((startColor.G + (endColor.G - startColor.G) * t) * 255)
        local b = math.floor((startColor.B + (endColor.B - startColor.B) * t) * 255)
        result = result .. string.format('<font color="rgb(%d,%d,%d)">%s</font>', r, g, b, text:sub(i, i))

-- ===== BLACK HOLE =====
OtherTab:Section({
    Title = "BLACK HOLE",
    Desc = "ดูดหีเเบบโหดๆ",
    TextXAlignment = "Center",
    Opened = true,
    Box = true,
})

local blackHoleActive = false
local blackHoleConnection = nil
local Attachment1 = nil

local function toggleBlackHole()
    blackHoleActive = not blackHoleActive
    
    if blackHoleActive then
        local char = Player.Character
        if not char then return end
        
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end
        
        local Folder = Instance.new("Folder")
        Folder.Name = "BlackHole"
        Folder.Parent = Workspace
        
        local Part = Instance.new("Part", Folder)
        Part.Anchored = true
        Part.CanCollide = false
        Part.Transparency = 1
        Part.Size = Vector3.new(100, 100, 100)
        
        Attachment1 = Instance.new("Attachment", Part)
        
        if not getgenv().Network then
            getgenv().Network = {
                BaseParts = {},
                Velocity = Vector3.new(999999, 999999, 999999)
            }
            
            Network.RetainPart = function(Part)
                if typeof(Part) == "Instance" and Part:IsA("BasePart") and Part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
                    table.insert(Network.BaseParts, Part)
                    Part.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
                    Part.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
            
            local function EnablePartControl()
                Player.ReplicationFocus = Workspace
                RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    sethiddenproperty(Player, "SimulationRadius", math.huge)
                    for _, Part in pairs(Network.BaseParts) do
                        if Part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
                            Part.Velocity = Network.Velocity
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            
            EnablePartControl()
        end
        
        local function ForcePart(v)
            if v:IsDescendantOf(char) then return end
            if v:IsA("BasePart") and not v.Anchored then
                if v.Parent and v.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then return end
                if v.Name == "Handle" then return end
                
                for _, x in next, v:GetChildren() do
                    if x:IsA("BodyAngularVelocity") or x:IsA("BodyForce") or x:IsA("BodyGyro") or 
                       x:IsA("BodyPosition") or x:IsA("BodyThrust") or x:IsA("BodyVelocity") or 
                       x:IsA("RocketPropulsion") or x:IsA("Torque") or x:IsA("AlignPosition") then
                        x:Destroy()
                    end
                end
                
                for _, att in pairs(v:GetChildren()) do
                    if att:IsA("Attachment") then att:Destroy() end
                end
                
                v.CanCollide = false
                
                local Torque = Instance.new("Torque", v)
                Torque.Torque = Vector3.new(Settings.BlackHolePower, Settings.BlackHolePower, Settings.BlackHolePower)
                
                local AlignPosition = Instance.new("AlignPosition", v)
                local Attachment2 = Instance.new("Attachment", v)
                
                Torque.Attachment0 = Attachment2
                AlignPosition.MaxForce = 9e18
                AlignPosition.MaxVelocity = 9e9
                AlignPosition.Responsiveness = 999999
                AlignPosition.Attachment0 = Attachment2
                AlignPosition.Attachment1 = Attachment1
            end
        end
        
        for _, v in next, Workspace:GetDescendants() do
            ForcePart(v)
        end
        
        Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(v)
            if blackHoleActive then
                task.wait(0.05)
                ForcePart(v)
            end
        end)
        
        blackHoleConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not blackHoleActive then return end
            
            local char = Player.Character
            if not char then return end
            
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp or not Attachment1 then return end
            
            Attachment1.WorldCFrame = hrp.CFrame
        end)
    else
        if blackHoleConnection then
            blackHoleConnection:Disconnect()
            blackHoleConnection = nil
        end
        
        if Attachment1 then
            local parent = Attachment1.Parent
            if parent and parent.Parent then
                parent.Parent:Destroy()
            end
            Attachment1 = nil
        end
    end
end

local blackHoleToggle = OtherTab:Toggle({
    Title = "หลุ่มดำดูดหีโหดๆ",
    Desc = "ดูดจนน้ำหีหลุดออกมา",
    Flag = "blackHoleEnabled",
    Value = Settings.BlackHoleEnabled,
    Callback = function(state)
        Settings.BlackHoleEnabled = state
        toggleBlackHole()
    end
})

-- ===== FUCK FLING =====
OtherTab:Section({
    Title = "Fuck Fling",
    Desc = "Fling",
    TextXAlignment = "Center",
    Opened = true,
    Box = true,
})

local flingActive = false
local flingTask = nil

local function startFling()
    flingActive = true
    
    flingTask = coroutine.create(function()
        local hrp, c, vel, movel = nil, nil, nil, 0.1
        
        while flingActive do
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            if flingActive then
                c = Player.Character
                hrp = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                
                if flingActive and c and c.Parent and hrp and hrp.Parent then
                    vel = hrp.Velocity
                    hrp.Velocity = vel * Settings.FlingPower + Vector3.new(0, Settings.FlingPower, 0)
                    RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
                    if c and c.Parent and hrp and hrp.Parent then
                        hrp.Velocity = vel
                    end
                    RunService.Stepped:Wait()
                    if c and c.Parent and hrp and hrp.Parent then
                        hrp.Velocity = vel + Vector3.new(0, movel, 0)
                        movel = movel * -1
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    
    coroutine.resume(flingTask)
end

local function stopFling()
    flingActive = false
    flingTask = nil
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not Settings.FlyEnabled then return end
    
    local char = Player.Character
    if not char then return end
    
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end
    
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end
    
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end
    
    -- เช็คว่านั่งอยู่หรือไม่
    if hum.Sit then
        local moveDir = hum.MoveDirection
        if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then 
            IsFlying = true 
        end
        
        if IsFlying then
            -- หยุด Animation นั่ง
            for _, track in pairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                if track.Name:lower():find("sit") or track.Animation.AnimationId:lower():find("sit") then
                    track:Stop(0.1)
                end
            end
            
            bv.Parent = hrp
            bg.Parent = hrp
            bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
            bg.CFrame = cam.CFrame
            bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
            
            local velocity = Vector3.zero
            if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
                local camLook = cam.CFrame.LookVector
                local camRight = cam.CFrame.RightVector
                velocity = (camLook * moveDir:Dot(camLook) + camRight * moveDir:Dot(camRight)).Unit * Settings.FlySpeed
            end
            
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) or hum.Jump then 
                velocity = velocity + Vector3.new(0, Settings.FlySpeed, 0) 
            end
            
            bv.Velocity = velocity
        end
    else
        IsFlying = false
        bv.Parent = nil
        bg.Parent = nil
    end
end)

    end

local ESPObjects = {}

local function RemoveESP(plr)
    local esp = ESPObjects[plr]
    if not esp then return end

    if esp.Tracer then
        esp.Tracer.Visible = false
        esp.Tracer:Remove()
    end

    if esp.Box then
        esp.Box.Visible = false
        esp.Box:Remove()
    end

    if esp.Highlight then
        esp.Highlight:Destroy()
    end

    if esp.Billboard then
        esp.Billboard:Destroy()
    end

    ESPObjects[plr] = nil
end

local function CreateESP(plr)
    if plr == Player then return end

    local function Setup(character)
        RemoveESP(plr)

        local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
        if not hrp then return end

        local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
        highlight.FillTransparency = 1
        highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
        highlight.OutlineColor = Settings.ESPColor
        highlight.Enabled = false
        highlight.Parent = character

        local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 30)
        billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
        billboard.Enabled = false
        billboard.Parent = hrp

        local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        label.TextSize = 14
        label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        label.TextColor3 = Settings.ESPColor
        label.Text = ""
        label.Parent = billboard

        local tracer = Drawing.new("Line")
        tracer.Visible = false
        tracer.Color = Settings.ESPColor
        tracer.Thickness = 1.5
        tracer.Transparency = 1
        tracer.ZIndex = 2

        local box = Drawing.new("Square")
        box.Visible = false
        box.Color = Settings.ESPColor
        box.Thickness = 2
        box.Filled = false
        box.Transparency = 0.5
        box.ZIndex = 1

        ESPObjects[plr] = {
            Highlight = highlight,
            Billboard = billboard,
            Label = label,
            Tracer = tracer,
            Box = box
        }
    end

    if plr.Character then
        Setup(plr.Character)
    end

    plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(Setup)
end

for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    CreateESP(plr)
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not Settings.ESPEnabled then
        for _, data in pairs(ESPObjects) do
            data.Tracer.Visible = false
            if data.Box then
                data.Box.Visible = false
            end
            data.Highlight.Enabled = false
            data.Billboard.Enabled = false
        end
        return
    end

    local myChar = Player.Character
    if not myChar then return end

    local myHRP = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myHRP then return end

    for plr, data in pairs(ESPObjects) do
        data.Tracer.Visible = false
        if data.Box then
            data.Box.Visible = false
        end
        data.Highlight.Enabled = false

        local char = plr.Character
        if not char then
            continue
        end

        local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if not hum or not hrp or hum.Health <= 0 then
            continue
        end

        local distance = math.floor((myHRP.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude)

        if Settings.BoxEnabled and data.Box then
            local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
            
            if onScreen then
                local sizeMultiplier = math.clamp(100 / (distance + 50), 0.5, 2)
                local boxWidth = 50 * sizeMultiplier
                local boxHeight = 80 * sizeMultiplier
                
                data.Box.Size = Vector2.new(boxWidth, boxHeight)
                data.Box.Position = Vector2.new(
                    pos.X - (boxWidth / 2),
                    pos.Y - (boxHeight / 2)
                )
                data.Box.Color = Settings.ESPColor
                data.Box.Visible = true
            end
        end

        if Settings.OutlineEnabled then
            data.Highlight.Enabled = true
            data.Highlight.OutlineColor = Settings.ESPColor
        end

        local txt = ""

        if Settings.NameEnabled then
            txt = plr.Name
        end

        if Settings.DistanceEnabled then
            if txt ~= "" then
                txt = txt .. " "
            end
            txt = txt .. "[" .. distance .. "m]"
        end

        data.Label.Text = txt
        data.Label.TextColor3 = Settings.ESPColor
        data.Billboard.Enabled = (Settings.NameEnabled or Settings.DistanceEnabled)

        if Settings.TracerEnabled then
            local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)

            if onScreen then
                data.Tracer.Visible = true
                data.Tracer.From = Vector2.new(
                    Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2,
                    0
                )
                data.Tracer.To = Vector2.new(
                    pos.X,
                    pos.Y
                )
                data.Tracer.Color = Settings.ESPColor
            end
        end
    end
end)

local function gradient(text, startColor, endColor)
    local result = ""
    for i = 1, #text do
        local t = (i - 1) / (#text - 1)
        local r = math.floor((startColor.R + (endColor.R - startColor.R) * t) * 255)
        local g = math.floor((startColor.G + (endColor.G - startColor.G) * t) * 255)
        local b = math.floor((startColor.B + (endColor.B - startColor.B) * t) * 255)
        result = result .. string.format('<font color="rgb(%d,%d,%d)">%s</font>', r, g, b, text:sub(i, i))
    end
    return result
end

local blackHoleActive = false
local blackHoleConnection = nil
local Attachment1 = nil

local function toggleBlackHole()
    blackHoleActive = not blackHoleActive
    
    if blackHoleActive then
        local char = Player.Character
        if not char then return end
        
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end
        
        local Folder = Instance.new("Folder")
        Folder.Name = "BlackHole"
        Folder.Parent = Workspace
        
        local Part = Instance.new("Part", Folder)
        Part.Anchored = true
        Part.CanCollide = false
        Part.Transparency = 1
        Part.Size = Vector3.new(100, 100, 100)
        
        Attachment1 = Instance.new("Attachment", Part)
        
        if not getgenv().Network then
            getgenv().Network = {
                BaseParts = {},
                Velocity = Vector3.new(999999, 999999, 999999)
            }
            
            Network.RetainPart = function(Part)
                if typeof(Part) == "Instance" and Part:IsA("BasePart") and Part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
                    table.insert(Network.BaseParts, Part)
                    Part.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
                    Part.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
            
            local function EnablePartControl()
                Player.ReplicationFocus = Workspace
                RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    sethiddenproperty(Player, "SimulationRadius", math.huge)
                    for _, Part in pairs(Network.BaseParts) do
                        if Part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
                            Part.Velocity = Network.Velocity
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            
            EnablePartControl()
        end
        
        local function ForcePart(v)
            if v:IsDescendantOf(char) then return end
            if v:IsA("BasePart") and not v.Anchored then
                if v.Parent and v.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then return end
                if v.Name == "Handle" then return end
                
                for _, x in next, v:GetChildren() do
                    if x:IsA("BodyAngularVelocity") or x:IsA("BodyForce") or x:IsA("BodyGyro") or 
                       x:IsA("BodyPosition") or x:IsA("BodyThrust") or x:IsA("BodyVelocity") or 
                       x:IsA("RocketPropulsion") or x:IsA("Torque") or x:IsA("AlignPosition") then
                        x:Destroy()
                    end
                end
                
                for _, att in pairs(v:GetChildren()) do
                    if att:IsA("Attachment") then att:Destroy() end
                end
                
                v.CanCollide = false
                
                local Torque = Instance.new("Torque", v)
                Torque.Torque = Vector3.new(Settings.BlackHolePower, Settings.BlackHolePower, Settings.BlackHolePower)
                
                local AlignPosition = Instance.new("AlignPosition", v)
                local Attachment2 = Instance.new("Attachment", v)
                
                Torque.Attachment0 = Attachment2
                AlignPosition.MaxForce = 9e18
                AlignPosition.MaxVelocity = 9e9
                AlignPosition.Responsiveness = 999999
                AlignPosition.Attachment0 = Attachment2
                AlignPosition.Attachment1 = Attachment1
            end
        end
        
        for _, v in next, Workspace:GetDescendants() do
            ForcePart(v)
        end
        
        Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(v)
            if blackHoleActive then
                task.wait(0.05)
                ForcePart(v)
            end
        end)
        
        blackHoleConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not blackHoleActive then return end
            
            local char = Player.Character
            if not char then return end
            
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp or not Attachment1 then return end
            
            Attachment1.WorldCFrame = hrp.CFrame
        end)
    else
        if blackHoleConnection then
            blackHoleConnection:Disconnect()
            blackHoleConnection = nil
        end
        
        if Attachment1 then
            local parent = Attachment1.Parent
            if parent and parent.Parent then
                parent.Parent:Destroy()
            end
            Attachment1 = nil
        end
    end
end

    if not hum then return end

    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

    -- เช็คว่านั่งอยู่หรือไม่
    if hum.Sit then
        local moveDir = hum.MoveDirection
        if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then 
            IsFlying = true

            local velocity = Vector3.zero

                velocity = velocity + Vector3.new(0, Settings.FlySpeed, 0)

            bv.Velocity = velocity

        bg.Parent = nil
    end

local ESPObjects = {}

local function RemoveESP(plr)
    local esp = ESPObjects[plr]
    if not esp then return end

    if esp.Tracer then
        esp.Tracer.Visible = false
        esp.Tracer:Remove()
    end

    if esp.Box then
        esp.Box.Visible = false
        esp.Box:Remove()
    end

    if esp.Highlight then
        esp.Highlight:Destroy()
    end

    if esp.Billboard then
        esp.Billboard:Destroy()
    end

    ESPObjects[plr] = nil
end

local function CreateESP(plr)
    if plr == Player then return end

    local function Setup(character)
        RemoveESP(plr)

        local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
        if not hrp then return end

        local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
        highlight.FillTransparency = 1
        highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
        highlight.OutlineColor = Settings.ESPColor
        highlight.Enabled = false
        highlight.Parent = character

        local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 30)
        billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
        billboard.Enabled = false
        billboard.Parent = hrp

        local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        label.TextSize = 14
        label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        label.TextColor3 = Settings.ESPColor
        label.Text = ""
        label.Parent = billboard

        local tracer = Drawing.new("Line")
        tracer.Visible = false
        tracer.Color = Settings.ESPColor
        tracer.Thickness = 1.5
        tracer.Transparency = 1
        tracer.ZIndex = 2

        local box = Drawing.new("Square")
        box.Visible = false
        box.Color = Settings.ESPColor
        box.Thickness = 2
        box.Filled = false
        box.Transparency = 0.5
        box.ZIndex = 1

        ESPObjects[plr] = {
            Highlight = highlight,
            Billboard = billboard,
            Label = label,
            Tracer = tracer,
            Box = box
        }
    end

    if plr.Character then
        Setup(plr.Character)
    end

    plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(Setup)
end

for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    CreateESP(plr)
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not Settings.ESPEnabled then
        for _, data in pairs(ESPObjects) do
            data.Tracer.Visible = false
            if data.Box then
                data.Box.Visible = false
            end
            data.Highlight.Enabled = false
            data.Billboard.Enabled = false
        end
        return
    end

    local myChar = Player.Character
    if not myChar then return end

    local myHRP = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myHRP then return end

    for plr, data in pairs(ESPObjects) do
        data.Tracer.Visible = false
        if data.Box then
            data.Box.Visible = false
        end
        data.Highlight.Enabled = false

        local char = plr.Character
        if not char then
            continue
        end

        local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if not hum or not hrp or hum.Health <= 0 then
            continue
        end

        local distance = math.floor((myHRP.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude)

        if Settings.BoxEnabled and data.Box then
            local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
            
            if onScreen then
                local sizeMultiplier = math.clamp(100 / (distance + 50), 0.5, 2)
                local boxWidth = 50 * sizeMultiplier
                local boxHeight = 80 * sizeMultiplier
                
                data.Box.Size = Vector2.new(boxWidth, boxHeight)
                data.Box.Position = Vector2.new(
                    pos.X - (boxWidth / 2),
                    pos.Y - (boxHeight / 2)
                )
                data.Box.Color = Settings.ESPColor
                data.Box.Visible = true
            end
        end

        if Settings.OutlineEnabled then
            data.Highlight.Enabled = true
            data.Highlight.OutlineColor = Settings.ESPColor
        end

        local txt = ""

        if Settings.NameEnabled then
            txt = plr.Name
        end

        if Settings.DistanceEnabled then
            if txt ~= "" then
                txt = txt .. " "
            end
            txt = txt .. "[" .. distance .. "m]"
        end

        data.Label.Text = txt
        data.Label.TextColor3 = Settings.ESPColor
        data.Billboard.Enabled = (Settings.NameEnabled or Settings.DistanceEnabled)

        if Settings.TracerEnabled then
            local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)

            if onScreen then
                data.Tracer.Visible = true
                data.Tracer.From = Vector2.new(
                    Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2,
                    0
                )
                data.Tracer.To = Vector2.new(
                    pos.X,
                    pos.Y
                )
                data.Tracer.Color = Settings.ESPColor
            end
        end
    end
end)

local function gradient(text, startColor, endColor)
    local result = ""
    for i = 1, #text do
        local t = (i - 1) / (#text - 1)
        local r = math.floor((startColor.R + (endColor.R - startColor.R) * t) * 255)
        local g = math.floor((startColor.G + (endColor.G - startColor.G) * t) * 255)
        local b = math.floor((startColor.B + (endColor.B - startColor.B) * t) * 255)
        result = result .. string.format('<font color="rgb(%d,%d,%d)">%s</font>', r, g, b, text:sub(i, i))
    end
    return result
end

})

local blackHoleActive = false
local blackHoleConnection = nil
local Attachment1 = nil

local function toggleBlackHole()
    blackHoleActive = not blackHoleActive
    
    if blackHoleActive then
        local char = Player.Character
        if not char then return end
        
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end
        
        local Folder = Instance.new("Folder")
        Folder.Name = "BlackHole"
        Folder.Parent = Workspace
        
        local Part = Instance.new("Part", Folder)
        Part.Anchored = true
        Part.CanCollide = false
        Part.Transparency = 1
        Part.Size = Vector3.new(100, 100, 100)
        
        Attachment1 = Instance.new("Attachment", Part)
        
        if not getgenv().Network then
            getgenv().Network = {
                BaseParts = {},
                Velocity = Vector3.new(999999, 999999, 999999)
            }
            
            Network.RetainPart = function(Part)
                if typeof(Part) == "Instance" and Part:IsA("BasePart") and Part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
                    table.insert(Network.BaseParts, Part)
                    Part.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
                    Part.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
            
            local function EnablePartControl()
                Player.ReplicationFocus = Workspace
                RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    sethiddenproperty(Player, "SimulationRadius", math.huge)
                    for _, Part in pairs(Network.BaseParts) do
                        if Part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
                            Part.Velocity = Network.Velocity
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            
            EnablePartControl()
        end
        
        local function ForcePart(v)
            if v:IsDescendantOf(char) then return end
            if v:IsA("BasePart") and not v.Anchored then
                if v.Parent and v.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then return end
                if v.Name == "Handle" then return end
                
                for _, x in next, v:GetChildren() do
                    if x:IsA("BodyAngularVelocity") or x:IsA("BodyForce") or x:IsA("BodyGyro") or 
                       x:IsA("BodyPosition") or x:IsA("BodyThrust") or x:IsA("BodyVelocity") or 
                       x:IsA("RocketPropulsion") or x:IsA("Torque") or x:IsA("AlignPosition") then
                        x:Destroy()
                    end
                end
                
                for _, att in pairs(v:GetChildren()) do
                    if att:IsA("Attachment") then att:Destroy() end
                end
                
                v.CanCollide = false
                
                local Torque = Instance.new("Torque", v)
                Torque.Torque = Vector3.new(Settings.BlackHolePower, Settings.BlackHolePower, Settings.BlackHolePower)
                
                local AlignPosition = Instance.new("AlignPosition", v)
                local Attachment2 = Instance.new("Attachment", v)
                
                Torque.Attachment0 = Attachment2
                AlignPosition.MaxForce = 9e18
                AlignPosition.MaxVelocity = 9e9
                AlignPosition.Responsiveness = 999999
                AlignPosition.Attachment0 = Attachment2
                AlignPosition.Attachment1 = Attachment1
            end
        end
        
        for _, v in next, Workspace:GetDescendants() do
            ForcePart(v)
        end
        
        Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(v)
            if blackHoleActive then
                task.wait(0.05)
                ForcePart(v)
            end
        end)
        
        blackHoleConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not blackHoleActive then return end
            
            local char = Player.Character
            if not char then return end
            
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp or not Attachment1 then return end
            
            Attachment1.WorldCFrame = hrp.CFrame
        end)
    else
        if blackHoleConnection then
            blackHoleConnection:Disconnect()
            blackHoleConnection = nil
        end
        
        if Attachment1 then
            local parent = Attachment1.Parent
            if parent and parent.Parent then
                parent.Parent:Destroy()
            end
            Attachment1 = nil
        end
    end
end

local function startFling()

-- ระบบบินหลัก (RenderStepped)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not Settings.FlyEnabled then return end
    
    local char = Player.Character
    if not char then return end
    
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end
    
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end
    
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end
    
    -- เช็คว่านั่งอยู่หรือไม่
    if hum.Sit then
        local moveDir = hum.MoveDirection
        if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then 
            IsFlying = true 
        end
        
        if IsFlying then
            -- หยุด Animation นั่ง
            for _, track in pairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                if track.Name:lower():find("sit") or track.Animation.AnimationId:lower():find("sit") then
                    track:Stop(0.1)
                end
            end
            
            bv.Parent = hrp
            bg.Parent = hrp
            bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
            bg.CFrame = cam.CFrame
            bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
            
            local velocity = Vector3.zero
            if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
                local camLook = cam.CFrame.LookVector
                local camRight = cam.CFrame.RightVector
                velocity = (camLook * moveDir:Dot(camLook) + camRight * moveDir:Dot(camRight)).Unit * Settings.FlySpeed
            end
            
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) or hum.Jump then 
                velocity = velocity + Vector3.new(0, Settings.FlySpeed, 0) 
            end
            
            bv.Velocity = velocity
        end
    else
        IsFlying = false
        bv.Parent = nil
        bg.Parent = nil
    end
end)

local ESPObjects = {}

local function RemoveESP(plr)
    local esp = ESPObjects[plr]
    if not esp then return end

    if esp.Tracer then
        esp.Tracer.Visible = false
        esp.Tracer:Remove()
    end

    if esp.Box then
        esp.Box.Visible = false
        esp.Box:Remove()
    end

    if esp.Highlight then
        esp.Highlight:Destroy()
    end

    if esp.Billboard then
        esp.Billboard:Destroy()
    end

    ESPObjects[plr] = nil
end

local function CreateESP(plr)
    if plr == Player then return end

    local function Setup(character)
        RemoveESP(plr)

        local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
        if not hrp then return end

        local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
        highlight.FillTransparency = 1
        highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
        highlight.OutlineColor = Settings.ESPColor
        highlight.Enabled = false
        highlight.Parent = character

    if not Settings.ESPEnabled then
        for _, data in pairs(ESPObjects) do
            data.Tracer.Visible = false
            if data.Box then
                data.Box.Visible = false
            end
            data.Highlight.Enabled = false
            data.Billboard.Enabled = false
        end
        return
    end

    local myChar = Player.Character
    if not myChar then return end

    local myHRP = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myHRP then return end

    for plr, data in pairs(ESPObjects) do
        data.Tracer.Visible = false
        if data.Box then
            data.Box.Visible = false
        end
        data.Highlight.Enabled = false

        local char = plr.Character
        if not char then
            continue
        end

        local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if not hum or not hrp or hum.Health <= 0 then
            continue
        end

        local distance = math.floor((myHRP.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude)

        if Settings.BoxEnabled and data.Box then
            local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
            
            if onScreen then
                local sizeMultiplier = math.clamp(100 / (distance + 50), 0.5, 2)
                local boxWidth = 50 * sizeMultiplier
                local boxHeight = 80 * sizeMultiplier
                
                data.Box.Size = Vector2.new(boxWidth, boxHeight)
                data.Box.Position = Vector2.new(
                    pos.X - (boxWidth / 2),
                    pos.Y - (boxHeight / 2)
                )
                data.Box.Color = Settings.ESPColor
                data.Box.Visible = true
            end
        end

        if Settings.OutlineEnabled then
            data.Highlight.Enabled = true
            data.Highlight.OutlineColor = Settings.ESPColor
        end

        local txt = ""

        if Settings.NameEnabled then
            txt = plr.Name
        end

        if Settings.DistanceEnabled then
            if txt ~= "" then
                txt = txt .. " "
            end
            txt = txt .. "[" .. distance .. "m]"
        end

        data.Label.Text = txt
        data.Label.TextColor3 = Settings.ESPColor
        data.Billboard.Enabled = (Settings.NameEnabled or Settings.DistanceEnabled)

        if Settings.TracerEnabled then
            local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)

            if onScreen then
                data.Tracer.Visible = true
                data.Tracer.From = Vector2.new(
                    Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2,
                    0
                )
                data.Tracer.To = Vector2.new(
                    pos.X,
                    pos.Y
                )
                data.Tracer.Color = Settings.ESPColor
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- ฟังก์ชันเปิด/ปิด head lock
local function toggleHeadLock()
    headLockActive = not headLockActive
    
    if headLockActive then
        print("✓ Head Lock เปิดใช้งาน")
    else
        print("✗ Head Lock ปิดใช้งาน")
        -- คืนค่าอพยพเดิม
        neckMotor.C0 = originalNeckC0
        neckMotor.C1 = originalNeckC1
    end
end

-- ฟังก์ชันล็อคหัว
local function lockHead()
    if not headLockActive then return end
    
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local cameraDirection = camera.CFrame.LookVector
    
    -- สร้างมุมมองใหม่
    local newHeadCF = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1, 0) * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(cameraDirection, math.rad(0))
    
    -- ใช้ Lerp เพื่อให้การเคลื่อนไหวเรียบ
    local targetC0 = neckMotor.C0:Lerp(
        rootPart.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(newHeadCF),
        lockStrength
    )
    
    neckMotor.C0 = targetC0
end

-- ตรวจจับการกดปุ่ม E
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
        toggleHeadLock()
    end
end)

-- อัปเดต head lock อย่างต่อเนื่อง
game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if headLockActive then
        lockHead()
    end
end)

-- ตรวจจับการตายของผู้เล่น
humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
    headLockActive = false
    neckMotor.C0 = originalNeckC0
    neckMotor.C1 = originalNeckC1
end)

local function gradient(text, startColor, endColor)
    local result = ""
    for i = 1, #text do
        local t = (i - 1) / (#text - 1)
        local r = math.floor((startColor.R + (endColor.R - startColor.R) * t) * 255)
        local g = math.floor((startColor.G + (endColor.G - startColor.G) * t) * 255)
        local b = math.floor((startColor.B + (endColor.B - startColor.B) * t) * 255)
        result = result .. string.format('<font color="rgb(%d,%d,%d)">%s</font>', r, g, b, text:sub(i, i))
    end
    return result
end

-- ====== ฟังก์ชันใหม่: รีโหลดกระสุน 7 วิ ======
local function reloadBullets()
    print("เริ่มรีโหลดกระสุน...")
    
    local char = Player.Character
    if not char then
        print("ไม่พบตัวละคร")
        return false
    end
    
    -- หา M4 ที่ถืออยู่
    local m4 = char:FindFirstChild("M4")
    if not m4 then
        -- ถ้าไม่มี M4 ให้ค้นหาใน Backpack และหยิบขึ้นมา
        local backpack = Player.Backpack
        if backpack then
            for _, tool in pairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
                if tool:IsA("Tool") and tool.Name == "M4" then
                    local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
                    if hum then
                        hum:EquipTool(tool)
                        task.wait(0.2)
                        m4 = char:FindFirstChild("M4")
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    if not m4 then
        print("ไม่พบ M4 ในตัวละครหรือ Backpack")
        return false
    end
    
    -- รีโหลด 7 ครั้ง (หรือตามจำนวนที่กำหนด)
    local reloadCount = 7
    local reloadDelay = 0.8 -- 0.5-1 วินาทีต่อกระบอก
    
    print("กำลังรีโหลด " .. reloadCount .. " ครั้ง...")
    
    for i = 1, reloadCount do
        -- หา Event การรีโหลด (อาจมีชื่อแตกต่างกันไป)
        local reloadEvent = m4:FindFirstChild("ReloadEvent") or m4:FindFirstChild("Reload") or m4:FindFirstChild("ShootEvent")
        
        if reloadEvent then
            pcall(function()
                reloadEvent:FireServer()
                print("รีโหลดครั้งที่ " .. i .. " สำเร็จ")
            end)
        else
            -- ถ้าไม่มี Event ให้ลองใช้วิธีอื่น
            pcall(function()
                -- ลองเรียกฟังก์ชันรีโหลดโดยตรง
                local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("ReloadEvent") or ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GunReload")
                if remote then
                    remote:FireServer("M4")
                    print("รีโหลดครั้งที่ " .. i .. " สำเร็จ (ผ่าน Remote)")
                end
            end)
        end
        
        -- รอ 0.5-1 วินาที (ใช้ random เพื่อความสมจริง)
        task.wait(reloadDelay + math.random(-5, 5) / 100)
    end
    
    print("รีโหลดกระสุนครบ " .. reloadCount .. " ครั้ง")
    return true
end

-- ====== ฟังก์ชันรีโหลดสำหรับปืนทั้งหมด ======
local function reloadAllGuns()
    print("เริ่มรีโหลดปืนทั้งหมด...")
    
    local char = Player.Character
    if not char then
        print("ไม่พบตัวละคร")
        return false
    end
    
    local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if not hum then
        print("ไม่พบ Humanoid")
        return false
    end
    
    -- เก็บปืนทั้งหมดที่มีใน Backpack
    local backpack = Player.Backpack
    local guns = {}
    
    if backpack then
        for _, tool in pairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
            if tool:IsA("Tool") and tool.Name == "M4" then
                table.insert(guns, tool)
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- ตรวจปืนที่ถืออยู่
    local equippedGun = char:FindFirstChild("M4")
    if equippedGun then
        table.insert(guns, 1, equippedGun)
    end
    
    if #guns == 0 then
        print("ไม่พบ M4 ใดๆ")
        return false
    end
    
    print("พบ M4 ทั้งหมด " .. #guns .. " กระบอก")
    
    -- รีโหลดทีละกระบอก
    for i, gun in ipairs(guns) do
        print("กำลังรีโหลดกระบอกที่ " .. i)
        
        -- หยิบปืนขึ้นมา
        local currentGun = char:FindFirstChild("M4")
        if currentGun and currentGun ~= gun then
            currentGun.Parent = Player.Backpack
            task.wait(0.05)
        end
        
        -- หยิบปืนที่ต้องการ
        if gun.Parent == Player.Backpack then
            hum:EquipTool(gun)
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
        
        -- รีโหลด
        local m4 = char:FindFirstChild("M4")
        if m4 then
            local reloadEvent = m4:FindFirstChild("ReloadEvent") or m4:FindFirstChild("Reload") or m4:FindFirstChild("ShootEvent")
            if reloadEvent then
                pcall(function()
                    reloadEvent:FireServer()
                    print("รีโหลดกระบอกที่ " .. i .. " สำเร็จ")
                end)
            else
                -- ลอง Remote
                pcall(function()
                    local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("ReloadEvent") or ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GunReload")
                    if remote then
                        remote:FireServer("M4")
                        print("รีโหลดกระบอกที่ " .. i .. " สำเร็จ (ผ่าน Remote)")
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        
        -- หน่วงเวลา 0.5-1 วินาที
        local delay = 0.7 + math.random() * 0.3 -- 0.7-1.0 วินาที
        task.wait(delay)
        
        -- เอาปืนออกไปเก็บ
        if char:FindFirstChild("M4") then
            char.M4.Parent = Player.Backpack
            task.wait(0.05)
        end
    end
    
    -- หยิบปืนกลับมา 1 กระบอก
    if #guns > 0 then
        local firstGun = guns[1]
        if firstGun and firstGun.Parent == Player.Backpack then
            hum:EquipTool(firstGun)
        end
    end
    
    print("รีโหลดปืนทั้งหมดเสร็จสิ้น")
    return true
end

local AutoAimSettings = {

    LockDistance = 250,

local targetPlayer = nil
local totalShots = 0
local totalHits = 0
local lastShotTime = 0
local TracerObjects = {}
local autoAimRunning = false
local autoAimConnection = nil
local currentGunIndex = 1
local currentAmmo = 30
local isDuplicating = false

local LOOP_COUNT = 7
local LOOP_DELAY = 0.001
local GUN_NAME = "M4"

-- ====== ฟังก์ชันรีโหลดอัตโนมัติทุก 7 วินาที ======
local autoReloadEnabled = false
local autoReloadConnection = nil

local function startAutoReload()
    if autoReloadConnection then
        autoReloadConnection:Disconnect()
        autoReloadConnection = nil
    end
    
    autoReloadEnabled = true
    autoReloadConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not autoReloadEnabled then return end
        
        local currentTime = tick()
        if currentTime % 7 < 0.1 then -- ทุก 7 วินาที
            task.spawn(function()
                print("Auto Reload triggered!")
                reloadAllGuns()
            end)
        end
    end)
    
    print("Auto Reload started (every 7 seconds)")
end

local function stopAutoReload()
    autoReloadEnabled = false
    if autoReloadConnection then
        autoReloadConnection:Disconnect()
        autoReloadConnection = nil
    end
    print("Auto Reload stopped")
end

-- ====== ฟังก์ชันรีโหลดด้วยปุ่ม ======
local function reloadGuns()
    print("Reloading guns...")
    return reloadAllGuns()
end

local function runExternalScript()
    print("Loading external M4 script...")
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://pastefy.app/N01QhUuY/raw"))()
    end)
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to load external script:", err)
    end
end

local function waitForM4Equipped()
    print("Waiting for M4 to be equipped...")
    local attempts = 0
    repeat
        task.wait(0.1)
        attempts = attempts + 1
        if attempts > 50 then
            warn("M4 equip timeout")
            return false
        end
    until Player.Character:FindFirstChild("M4")
    print("M4 equipped!")
    return true
end

local function unequipM4()
    print("Unequipping M4...")
    local m4 = Player.Character:FindFirstChild("M4")
    if m4 then
        m4.Parent = Player.Backpack
        task.wait(0.1)
        print("M4 unequipped!")
        return true
    else
        print("M4 not found in Character")
        return false
    end
end

local function saveM4()
    print("Saving M4 to storage...")
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        local toolStorage = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("ToolStorage")
        if toolStorage then
            local toolsStorage = toolStorage:FindFirstChild("ToolsStorage")
            if toolsStorage then
                toolsStorage:FireServer("Save", "M4")
                print("M4 saved!")
                return true
            end
        end
        return false
    end)
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to save M4:", err)
    end
    return success
end

local function retrieveM4()
    print("Retrieving M4 from storage...")
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        local toolStorage = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("ToolStorage")
        if toolStorage then
            local toolsStorage = toolStorage:FindFirstChild("ToolsStorage")
            if toolsStorage then
                toolsStorage:FireServer("Get", "M4")
                print("M4 retrieved!")
                return true
            end
        end
        return false
    end)
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to retrieve M4:", err)
    end
    return success
end

local function startDuplication()
    if isDuplicating then return end
    isDuplicating = true
    
    print("Starting M4 Duplication Loop...")
    
    retrieveM4()
    task.wait(1)
    
    for i = 1, LOOP_COUNT do
        print(string.format("Loop %d/%d", i, LOOP_COUNT))
        
        runExternalScript()
        
        if waitForM4Equipped() then
            Event:Fire()
            print("Local Event Fired for M4!")
            
            task.wait(0.2)
            unequipM4()
            
            task.wait(0.2)
            saveM4()
        else
            warn("Skipping loop due to equip failure")
        end
        
        task.wait(LOOP_DELAY)
    end
    
    print("M4 Duplication complete! Now retrieving all M4s...")
    
    for i = 1, LOOP_COUNT do
        print(string.format("Retrieving M4 %d/%d", i, LOOP_COUNT))
        retrieveM4()
        task.wait(0.05)
    end
    
    print("Duplication complete!")
    isDuplicating = false
end

local function getAllM4s()
    local guns = {}
    local backpack = Player.Backpack
    if not backpack then return guns end
    
    for _, tool in pairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
        if tool:IsA("Tool") and tool.Name == "M4" then
            table.insert(guns, tool)
        end
    end
    return guns
end

local function switchM4()
    local guns = getAllM4s()
    
    if #guns == 0 then
        return false
    end
    
    local character = Player.Character
    if character then
        local equippedGun = character:FindFirstChild("M4")
        if equippedGun then
            equippedGun.Parent = Player.Backpack
        end
    end
    
    if currentGunIndex > #guns then
        currentGunIndex = 1
    end
    
    local selectedGun = guns[currentGunIndex]
    
    if selectedGun and character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        character.Humanoid:EquipTool(selectedGun)
        currentGunIndex = currentGunIndex + 1
        currentAmmo = AutoAimSettings.MaxAmmo
        
        task.spawn(function()
            wait(0.05)
            if character:FindFirstChild("M4") then
                local gun = character.M4
                for _, part in pairs(gun:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("MeshPart") then
                        part.Transparency = 1
                    elseif part:IsA("Decal") or part:IsA("Texture") then
                        part.Transparency = 1
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        
        return true
    end
    
    return false
end

local function shootAllGuns()
    local guns = getAllM4s()
    if #guns == 0 then
        return false
    end
    
    local character = Player.Character
    if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        return false
    end
    
    local successCount = 0
    local targetPos = nil
    
    if targetPlayer then
        local targetChar = targetPlayer.Character
        if targetChar then
            local targetPart = targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if targetPart then
                targetPos = targetPart.Position
            end
        end
    end
    
    if not targetPos then
        local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if rootPart then
            targetPos = rootPart.Position + rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 100
        else
            return false
        end
    end
    
    for _, gun in ipairs(guns) do
        gun.Parent = character
        
        local shootEvent = gun:FindFirstChild("ShootEvent")
        if shootEvent then
            task.spawn(function()
                pcall(function()
                    shootEvent:FireServer(targetPos)
                    totalShots = totalShots + 1
                    if targetPlayer then
                        totalHits = totalHits + 1
                    end
                end)
            end)
            successCount = successCount + 1
        end
        
        task.wait(0.01)
        gun.Parent = Player.Backpack
    end
    
    if successCount > 0 and #guns > 0 then
        local firstGun = guns[1]
        if firstGun then
            firstGun.Parent = character
            task.wait(0.02)
            task.spawn(function()
                if character:FindFirstChild("M4") then
                    local gun = character.M4
                    for _, part in pairs(gun:GetDescendants()) do
                        if part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("MeshPart") then
                            part.Transparency = 1
                        elseif part:IsA("Decal") or part:IsA("Texture") then
                            part.Transparency = 1
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    
    return successCount > 0
end

local function equipM4()
    local guns = getAllM4s()
    
    if #guns == 0 then
        return false
    end
    
    local character = Player.Character
    if character then
        local equippedGun = character:FindFirstChild("M4")
        if equippedGun then
            equippedGun.Parent = Player.Backpack
        end
    end
    
    local firstGun = guns[1]
    if firstGun and character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        character.Humanoid:EquipTool(firstGun)
        currentGunIndex = 2
        currentAmmo = AutoAimSettings.MaxAmmo
        
        task.spawn(function()
            wait(0.05)
            if character:FindFirstChild("M4") then
                local gun = character.M4
                for _, part in pairs(gun:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("MeshPart") then
                        part.Transparency = 1
                    elseif part:IsA("Decal") or part:IsA("Texture") then
                        part.Transparency = 1
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        
        return true
    end
    
    return false
end

local function getShootEvent()
    local character = Player.Character
    if not character then return nil end
    
    local m4 = character:FindFirstChild("M4")
    if not m4 then return nil end
    
    return m4:FindFirstChild("ShootEvent")
end

local function findTarget()
    local character = Player.Character
    if not character then return nil end
    
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then return nil end
    
    local myPos = rootPart.Position
    
    if AutoAimSettings.LockMode == "Specific" and AutoAimSettings.SpecificTarget then
        local targetChar = AutoAimSettings.SpecificTarget.Character
        if targetChar then
            local targetRoot = targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local targetHum = targetChar:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            
            if targetRoot and targetHum and targetHum.Health > 0 then
                local distance = (myPos - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude
                if distance <= AutoAimSettings.LockDistance then
                    if not AutoAimSettings.BypassWalls then
                        local rayOrigin = rootPart.Position
                        local rayDirection = (targetRoot.Position - rayOrigin).Unit * distance
                        local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
                        raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character, targetChar}
                        raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
                        raycastParams.IgnoreWater = true
                        local rayResult = workspace:Raycast(rayOrigin, rayDirection, raycastParams)
                        if rayResult and not rayResult.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetChar) then
                            return nil
                        end
                    end
                    return AutoAimSettings.SpecificTarget
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    
    if AutoAimSettings.LockMode == "ByName" and AutoAimSettings.TargetName ~= "" then
        for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= Player and string.lower(player.Name):find(string.lower(AutoAimSettings.TargetName)) then
                local targetChar = player.Character
                if targetChar then
                    local targetRoot = targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local targetHum = targetChar:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
                    
                    if targetRoot and targetHum and targetHum.Health > 0 then
                        local distance = (myPos - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude
                        if distance <= AutoAimSettings.LockDistance then
                            if not AutoAimSettings.BypassWalls then
                                local rayOrigin = rootPart.Position
                                local rayDirection = (targetRoot.Position - rayOrigin).Unit * distance
                                local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
                                raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character, targetChar}
                                raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
                                raycastParams.IgnoreWater = true
                                local rayResult = workspace:Raycast(rayOrigin, rayDirection, raycastParams)
                                if rayResult and not rayResult.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetChar) then
                                    return nil
                                end
                            end
                            return player
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    
    if AutoAimSettings.LockMode == "Closest" then
        local closestPlayer = nil
        local shortestDistance = AutoAimSettings.LockDistance
        
        for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= Player then
                local targetChar = player.Character
                if targetChar then
                    local targetRoot = targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local targetHum = targetChar:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
                    
                    if targetRoot and targetHum and targetHum.Health > 0 then
                        local distance = (myPos - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude
                        
                        if distance < shortestDistance then
                            if not AutoAimSettings.BypassWalls then
                                local rayOrigin = rootPart.Position
                                local rayDirection = (targetRoot.Position - rayOrigin).Unit * distance
                                local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
                                raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character, targetChar}
                                raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
                                raycastParams.IgnoreWater = true
                                local rayResult = workspace:Raycast(rayOrigin, rayDirection, raycastParams)
                                if rayResult and not rayResult.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetChar) then
                                    return closestPlayer
                                end
                            end
                            shortestDistance = distance
                            closestPlayer = player
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        
        return closestPlayer
    end
    
    return nil
end

local function createTracer(player)
    if not player or player == Player then return end
    
    if TracerObjects[player] then
        TracerObjects[player]:Remove()
        TracerObjects[player] = nil
    end
    
    local tracer = Drawing.new("Line")
    tracer.Visible = false
    tracer.Color = AutoAimSettings.TracerColor
    tracer.Thickness = 2
    tracer.Transparency = 0.8
    tracer.ZIndex = 10
    
    TracerObjects[player] = tracer
    return tracer
end

local function updateTracers()
    local myChar = Player.Character
    if not myChar then return end
    
    local myRoot = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return end
    
    local myPos = myRoot.Position
    local myScreenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(myPos)
    
    for player, tracer in pairs(TracerObjects) do
        tracer.Visible = false
        
        if AutoAimSettings.TracerEnabled and AutoAimSettings.Enabled then
            local char = player.Character
            if char then
                local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
                
                if root and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                    local targetPos, targetOnScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
                    
                    if targetOnScreen then
                        tracer.Visible = true
                        tracer.From = Vector2.new(myScreenPos.X, myScreenPos.Y)
                        tracer.To = Vector2.new(targetPos.X, targetPos.Y)
                        tracer.Color = AutoAimSettings.TracerColor
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local function createTracersForAll()
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= Player then
            createTracer(player)
        end
    end
end

local function shoot(targetPos)
    local shootEvent = getShootEvent()
    
    if not shootEvent then
        if equipM4() then
            wait(0.05)
            shootEvent = getShootEvent()
        end
        
        if not shootEvent then
            return false
        end
    end
    
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        shootEvent:FireServer(targetPos)
    end)
    
    if success then
        totalShots = totalShots + 1
        currentAmmo = currentAmmo - 1
        
        if AutoAimSettings.GunSwitchEnabled and AutoAimSettings.ShootMode == "Switch" then
            local guns = getAllM4s()
            if #guns > 1 then
                task.spawn(function()
                    wait(0.001)
                    switchM4()
                    currentAmmo = AutoAimSettings.MaxAmmo
                end)
            end
        end
        
        if currentAmmo <= 0 then
            currentAmmo = AutoAimSettings.MaxAmmo
        end
        
        return true
    else
        print("Shoot error:", err)
    end
    
    return false
end

local function startAutoAim()
    if autoAimRunning then return end
    autoAimRunning = true
    
    createTracersForAll()
    equipM4()
    
    autoAimConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not AutoAimSettings.Enabled then return end
        
        local currentTime = tick()
        if currentTime - lastShotTime < AutoAimSettings.FireRate then
            return
        end
        
        local newTarget = nil
        if AutoAimSettings.LockMode == "Specific" and AutoAimSettings.SpecificTarget then
            local targetChar = AutoAimSettings.SpecificTarget.Character
            if targetChar then
                local targetHum = targetChar:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
                if targetHum and targetHum.Health > 0 then
                    newTarget = AutoAimSettings.SpecificTarget
                elseif AutoAimSettings.AutoStopOnDeath then
                    targetPlayer = nil
                    return
                end
            else
                if AutoAimSettings.AutoStopOnDeath then
                    targetPlayer = nil
                    return
                end
            end
        end
        
        if not newTarget then
            newTarget = findTarget()
        end
        
        if AutoAimSettings.AimLock then
            targetPlayer = newTarget
        end
        
        local targetPos = nil
        
        if targetPlayer then
            local targetChar = targetPlayer.Character
            if targetChar then
                local targetPart = targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if targetPart then
                    targetPos = targetPart.Position
                end
            end
        end
        
        if not targetPos then
            local character = Player.Character
            if character then
                local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if rootPart then
                    targetPos = rootPart.Position + rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 100
                end
            end
        end
        
        if targetPos then
            local success = false
            
            if AutoAimSettings.ShootMode == "All" then
                local guns = getAllM4s()
                if #guns > 0 then
                    success = shootAllGuns()
                else
                    success = shoot(targetPos)
                end
            else
                success = shoot(targetPos)
            end
            
            if success then
                lastShotTime = currentTime
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function stopAutoAim()
    if autoAimConnection then
        autoAimConnection:Disconnect()
        autoAimConnection = nil
    end
    autoAimRunning = false
    targetPlayer = nil
end

local function setSpecificTarget(playerName)
    local player = Players:FindFirstChild(playerName)

        AutoAimSettings.LockMode = "Specific"
        targetPlayer = player

    end
    return false
end

local blackHoleActive = false
local blackHoleConnection = nil
local Attachment1 = nil

local function toggleBlackHole()
    blackHoleActive = not blackHoleActive
    
    if blackHoleActive then
        local char = Player.Character
        if not char then return end
        
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end
        
        local Folder = Instance.new("Folder")
        Folder.Name = "BlackHole"
        Folder.Parent = Workspace
        
        local Part = Instance.new("Part", Folder)
        Part.Anchored = true
        Part.CanCollide = false
        Part.Transparency = 1
        Part.Size = Vector3.new(100, 100, 100)
        
        Attachment1 = Instance.new("Attachment", Part)
        
        if not getgenv().Network then
            getgenv().Network = {
                BaseParts = {},
                Velocity = Vector3.new(999999, 999999, 999999)
            }
            
            Network.RetainPart = function(Part)
                if typeof(Part) == "Instance" and Part:IsA("BasePart") and Part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
                    table.insert(Network.BaseParts, Part)
                    Part.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
                    Part.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
            
            local function EnablePartControl()
                Player.ReplicationFocus = Workspace
                RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    sethiddenproperty(Player, "SimulationRadius", math.huge)
                    for _, Part in pairs(Network.BaseParts) do
                        if Part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
                            Part.Velocity = Network.Velocity
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            
            EnablePartControl()
        end
        
        local function ForcePart(v)
            if v:IsDescendantOf(char) then return end
            if v:IsA("BasePart") and not v.Anchored then
                if v.Parent and v.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then return end
                if v.Name == "Handle" then return end
                
                for _, x in next, v:GetChildren() do
                    if x:IsA("BodyAngularVelocity") or x:IsA("BodyForce") or x:IsA("BodyGyro") or 
                       x:IsA("BodyPosition") or x:IsA("BodyThrust") or x:IsA("BodyVelocity") or 
                       x:IsA("RocketPropulsion") or x:IsA("Torque") or x:IsA("AlignPosition") then
                        x:Destroy()
                    end
                end
                
                for _, att in pairs(v:GetChildren()) do
                    if att:IsA("Attachment") then att:Destroy() end
                end
                
                v.CanCollide = false
                
                local Torque = Instance.new("Torque", v)
                Torque.Torque = Vector3.new(Settings.BlackHolePower, Settings.BlackHolePower, Settings.BlackHolePower)
                
                local AlignPosition = Instance.new("AlignPosition", v)
                local Attachment2 = Instance.new("Attachment", v)
                
                Torque.Attachment0 = Attachment2
                AlignPosition.MaxForce = 9e18
                AlignPosition.MaxVelocity = 9e9
                AlignPosition.Responsiveness = 999999
                AlignPosition.Attachment0 = Attachment2
                AlignPosition.Attachment1 = Attachment1
            end
        end
        
        for _, v in next, Workspace:GetDescendants() do
            ForcePart(v)
        end
        
        Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(v)
            if blackHoleActive then
                task.wait(0.05)
                ForcePart(v)
            end
        end)
        
        blackHoleConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not blackHoleActive then return end
            
            local char = Player.Character
            if not char then return end
            
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp or not Attachment1 then return end
            
            Attachment1.WorldCFrame = hrp.CFrame
        end)
    else
        if blackHoleConnection then
            blackHoleConnection:Disconnect()
            blackHoleConnection = nil
        end
        
        if Attachment1 then
            local parent = Attachment1.Parent
            if parent and parent.Parent then
                parent.Parent:Destroy()
            end
            Attachment1 = nil
        end
    end
end

local flingActive = false

local function startFling()
    flingActive = true
    
    flingTask = coroutine.create(function()
        local hrp, c, vel, movel = nil, nil, nil, 0.1
        
        while flingActive do
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            if flingActive then
                c = Player.Character
                hrp = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                
                if flingActive and c and c.Parent and hrp and hrp.Parent then
                    vel = hrp.Velocity
                    hrp.Velocity = vel * Settings.FlingPower + Vector3.new(0, Settings.FlingPower, 0)
                    RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
                    if c and c.Parent and hrp and hrp.Parent then
                        hrp.Velocity = vel
                    end
                    RunService.Stepped:Wait()
                    if c and c.Parent and hrp and hrp.Parent then
                        hrp.Velocity = vel + Vector3.new(0, movel, 0)
                        movel = movel * -1
                    end
                end
            end
        end

    coroutine.resume(flingTask)
end

        if IsFlying then
            for _, track in pairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do

                local camRight = cam.CFrame.RightVector

            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) or hum.Jump then 
                velocity = velocity + Vector3.new(0, Settings.FlySpeed, 0)

        local targetVelocity = moveDir.Unit * Settings.TPWalkSpeed
        currentVelocity = currentVelocity:Lerp(targetVelocity, 0.15)
        hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + (currentVelocity * dt * 60)
    else
        currentVelocity = currentVelocity:Lerp(Vector3.zero, 0.2)
    end
end)

local ESPObjects = {}

local function RemoveESP(plr)
    local esp = ESPObjects[plr]
    if not esp then return end

    if esp.Tracer then
        esp.Tracer.Visible = false
        esp.Tracer:Remove()
    end

    if esp.Box then
        esp.Box.Visible = false
        esp.Box:Remove()
    end

    if esp.Highlight then
        esp.Highlight:Destroy()
    end

    if esp.Billboard then
        esp.Billboard:Destroy()
    end

    ESPObjects[plr] = nil
end

local function CreateESP(plr)
    if plr == Player then return end

    local function Setup(character)
        RemoveESP(plr)

        local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
        if not hrp then return end

        local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
        highlight.FillTransparency = 1
        highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
        highlight.OutlineColor = Settings.ESPColor
        highlight.Enabled = false
        highlight.Parent = character

        local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 30)
        billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
        billboard.Enabled = false
        billboard.Parent = hrp

        local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        label.TextSize = 14
        label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        label.TextColor3 = Settings.ESPColor
        label.Text = ""
        label.Parent = billboard

        local tracer = Drawing.new("Line")
        tracer.Visible = false
        tracer.Color = Settings.ESPColor
        tracer.Thickness = 1.5
        tracer.Transparency = 1
        tracer.ZIndex = 2

        local box = Drawing.new("Square")
        box.Visible = false
        box.Color = Settings.ESPColor
        box.Thickness = 2
        box.Filled = false
        box.Transparency = 0.5
        box.ZIndex = 1

        ESPObjects[plr] = {
            Highlight = highlight,
            Billboard = billboard,
            Label = label,
            Tracer = tracer,
            Box = box
        }
    end

    if plr.Character then
        Setup(plr.Character)
    end

    plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(Setup)
end
