    if not myChar then return end

    local myHRP = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myHRP then return end

    for plr, data in pairs(ESPObjects) do
        data.Tracer.Visible = false
        if data.Box then
            data.Box.Visible = false
        end
        data.Highlight.Enabled = false

        local char = plr.Character
        if not char then
            continue
        end

        local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if not hum or not hrp or hum.Health <= 0 then
            continue
        end

        local distance = math.floor((myHRP.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude)

        if Settings.BoxEnabled and data.Box then
            local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
            
            if onScreen then
                local sizeMultiplier = math.clamp(100 / (distance + 50), 0.5, 2)
                local boxWidth = 50 * sizeMultiplier
                local boxHeight = 80 * sizeMultiplier
                
                data.Box.Size = Vector2.new(boxWidth, boxHeight)
                data.Box.Position = Vector2.new(
                    pos.X - (boxWidth / 2),
                    pos.Y - (boxHeight / 2)
                )
                data.Box.Color = Settings.ESPColor
                data.Box.Visible = true
            end
        end

        if Settings.OutlineEnabled then
            data.Highlight.Enabled = true
            data.Highlight.OutlineColor = Settings.ESPColor
        end

        local txt = ""

        if Settings.NameEnabled then
            txt = plr.Name
        end

        if Settings.DistanceEnabled then
            if txt ~= "" then
                txt = txt .. " "
            end
            txt = txt .. "[" .. distance .. "m]"
        end

        data.Label.Text = txt
        data.Label.TextColor3 = Settings.ESPColor
        data.Billboard.Enabled = (Settings.NameEnabled or Settings.DistanceEnabled)

        if Settings.TracerEnabled then
            local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)

            if onScreen then
                data.Tracer.Visible = true
                data.Tracer.From = Vector2.new(
                    Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2,
                    0
                )
                data.Tracer.To = Vector2.new(
                    pos.X,
                    pos.Y
                )
                data.Tracer.Color = Settings.ESPColor
            end
        end
    end
end)

local function gradient(text, startColor, endColor)
    local result = ""
    for i = 1, #text do
        local t = (i - 1) / (#text - 1)
        local r = math.floor((startColor.R + (endColor.R - startColor.R) * t) * 255)
        local g = math.floor((startColor.G + (endColor.G - startColor.G) * t) * 255)
        local b = math.floor((startColor.B + (endColor.B - startColor.B) * t) * 255)
        result = result .. string.format('<font color="rgb(%d,%d,%d)">%s</font>', r, g, b, text:sub(i, i))

    return result
end

local blackHoleActive = false
local blackHoleConnection = nil
local Attachment1 = nil

local function toggleBlackHole()
    blackHoleActive = not blackHoleActive
    
    if blackHoleActive then
        local char = Player.Character
        if not char then return end
        
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end
        
        local Folder = Instance.new("Folder")
        Folder.Name = "BlackHole"
        Folder.Parent = Workspace
        
        local Part = Instance.new("Part", Folder)
        Part.Anchored = true
        Part.CanCollide = false
        Part.Transparency = 1
        Part.Size = Vector3.new(100, 100, 100)
        
        Attachment1 = Instance.new("Attachment", Part)
        
        if not getgenv().Network then
            getgenv().Network = {
                BaseParts = {},
                Velocity = Vector3.new(999999, 999999, 999999)
            }
            
            Network.RetainPart = function(Part)
                if typeof(Part) == "Instance" and Part:IsA("BasePart") and Part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
                    table.insert(Network.BaseParts, Part)
                    Part.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
                    Part.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
            
            local function EnablePartControl()
                Player.ReplicationFocus = Workspace
                RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    sethiddenproperty(Player, "SimulationRadius", math.huge)
                    for _, Part in pairs(Network.BaseParts) do
                        if Part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
                            Part.Velocity = Network.Velocity
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            
            EnablePartControl()
        end
        
        local function ForcePart(v)
            if v:IsDescendantOf(char) then return end
            if v:IsA("BasePart") and not v.Anchored then
                if v.Parent and v.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then return end
                if v.Name == "Handle" then return end
                
                for _, x in next, v:GetChildren() do
                    if x:IsA("BodyAngularVelocity") or x:IsA("BodyForce") or x:IsA("BodyGyro") or 
                       x:IsA("BodyPosition") or x:IsA("BodyThrust") or x:IsA("BodyVelocity") or 
                       x:IsA("RocketPropulsion") or x:IsA("Torque") or x:IsA("AlignPosition") then
                        x:Destroy()
                    end
                end
                
                for _, att in pairs(v:GetChildren()) do
                    if att:IsA("Attachment") then att:Destroy() end
                end
                
                v.CanCollide = false
                
                local Torque = Instance.new("Torque", v)
                Torque.Torque = Vector3.new(Settings.BlackHolePower, Settings.BlackHolePower, Settings.BlackHolePower)
                
                local AlignPosition = Instance.new("AlignPosition", v)
                local Attachment2 = Instance.new("Attachment", v)
                
                Torque.Attachment0 = Attachment2
                AlignPosition.MaxForce = 9e18
                AlignPosition.MaxVelocity = 9e9
                AlignPosition.Responsiveness = 999999
                AlignPosition.Attachment0 = Attachment2
                AlignPosition.Attachment1 = Attachment1
            end
        end
        
        for _, v in next, Workspace:GetDescendants() do
            ForcePart(v)
        end
        
        Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(v)
            if blackHoleActive then
                task.wait(0.05)
                ForcePart(v)
            end
        end)
        
        blackHoleConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not blackHoleActive then return end
            
            local char = Player.Character
            if not char then return end
            
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp or not Attachment1 then return end
            
            Attachment1.WorldCFrame = hrp.CFrame
        end)
    else
        if blackHoleConnection then
            blackHoleConnection:Disconnect()
            blackHoleConnection = nil
        end
        
        if Attachment1 then
            local parent = Attachment1.Parent
            if parent and parent.Parent then
                parent.Parent:Destroy()
            end
            Attachment1 = nil
        end
    end
end

-- ระบบบินหลัก (RenderStepped)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not Settings.FlyEnabled then return end
    
    local char = Player.Character
    if not char then return end
    
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end
    
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end
    
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end
    
    -- เช็คว่านั่งอยู่หรือไม่
    if hum.Sit then
        local moveDir = hum.MoveDirection
        if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then 
            IsFlying = true 
        end
        
        if IsFlying then
            -- หยุด Animation นั่ง
            for _, track in pairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                if track.Name:lower():find("sit") or track.Animation.AnimationId:lower():find("sit") then
                    track:Stop(0.1)
                end
            end
            
            bv.Parent = hrp
            bg.Parent = hrp
            bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
            bg.CFrame = cam.CFrame
            bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
            
            local velocity = Vector3.zero
            if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
                local camLook = cam.CFrame.LookVector
                local camRight = cam.CFrame.RightVector
                velocity = (camLook * moveDir:Dot(camLook) + camRight * moveDir:Dot(camRight)).Unit * Settings.FlySpeed
            end
            
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) or hum.Jump then 
                velocity = velocity + Vector3.new(0, Settings.FlySpeed, 0) 
            end
            
            bv.Velocity = velocity
        end
    else
        IsFlying = false
        bv.Parent = nil
        bg.Parent = nil
    end
end)

local ESPObjects = {}

local function RemoveESP(plr)
    local esp = ESPObjects[plr]
    if not esp then return end

    if esp.Tracer then
        esp.Tracer.Visible = false
        esp.Tracer:Remove()
    end

    if esp.Box then
        esp.Box.Visible = false
        esp.Box:Remove()
    end

    if esp.Highlight then
        esp.Highlight:Destroy()
    end

    if esp.Billboard then
        esp.Billboard:Destroy()
    end

    ESPObjects[plr] = nil
end

local function CreateESP(plr)
    if plr == Player then return end

    local function Setup(character)
        RemoveESP(plr)

        local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
        if not hrp then return end

        local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
        highlight.FillTransparency = 1
        highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
        highlight.OutlineColor = Settings.ESPColor
        highlight.Enabled = false
        highlight.Parent = character

        local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 30)
        billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
        billboard.Enabled = false
        billboard.Parent = hrp

        local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        label.TextSize = 14
        label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        label.TextColor3 = Settings.ESPColor
        label.Text = ""
        label.Parent = billboard

        local tracer = Drawing.new("Line")
        tracer.Visible = false
        tracer.Color = Settings.ESPColor
        tracer.Thickness = 1.5

    if not Settings.ESPEnabled then
        for _, data in pairs(ESPObjects) do
            data.Tracer.Visible = false
            if data.Box then
                data.Box.Visible = false
            end
            data.Highlight.Enabled = false
            data.Billboard.Enabled = false
        end
        return
    end

    local myChar = Player.Character
    if not myChar then return end

    local myHRP = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myHRP then return end

    for plr, data in pairs(ESPObjects) do
        data.Tracer.Visible = false
        if data.Box then
            data.Box.Visible = false
        end
        data.Highlight.Enabled = false

        local char = plr.Character
        if not char then
            continue
        end

        local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if not hum or not hrp or hum.Health <= 0 then
            continue
        end

        local distance = math.floor((myHRP.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude)

        if Settings.BoxEnabled and data.Box then
            local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
            
            if onScreen then
                local sizeMultiplier = math.clamp(100 / (distance + 50), 0.5, 2)
                local boxWidth = 50 * sizeMultiplier
                local boxHeight = 80 * sizeMultiplier
                
                data.Box.Size = Vector2.new(boxWidth, boxHeight)
                data.Box.Position = Vector2.new(
                    pos.X - (boxWidth / 2),
                    pos.Y - (boxHeight / 2)
                )
                data.Box.Color = Settings.ESPColor
                data.Box.Visible = true
            end
        end

        if Settings.OutlineEnabled then
            data.Highlight.Enabled = true
            data.Highlight.OutlineColor = Settings.ESPColor
        end

        local txt = ""

        if Settings.NameEnabled then
            txt = plr.Name
        end

        if Settings.DistanceEnabled then
            if txt ~= "" then
                txt = txt .. " "
            end
            txt = txt .. "[" .. distance .. "m]"
        end

        data.Label.Text = txt
        data.Label.TextColor3 = Settings.ESPColor
        data.Billboard.Enabled = (Settings.NameEnabled or Settings.DistanceEnabled)

        if Settings.TracerEnabled then
            local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)

            if onScreen then
                data.Tracer.Visible = true
                data.Tracer.From = Vector2.new(
                    Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2,
                    0
                )
                data.Tracer.To = Vector2.new(
                    pos.X,
                    pos.Y
                )
                data.Tracer.Color = Settings.ESPColor
            end
        end
    end
end)

local function gradient(text, startColor, endColor)
    local result = ""
    for i = 1, #text do
        local t = (i - 1) / (#text - 1)
        local r = math.floor((startColor.R + (endColor.R - startColor.R) * t) * 255)
        local g = math.floor((startColor.G + (endColor.G - startColor.G) * t) * 255)
        local b = math.floor((startColor.B + (endColor.B - startColor.B) * t) * 255)
        result = result .. string.format('<font color="rgb(%d,%d,%d)">%s</font>', r, g, b, text:sub(i, i))

    return result
end

local blackHoleActive = false
local blackHoleConnection = nil
local Attachment1 = nil

local function toggleBlackHole()
    blackHoleActive = not blackHoleActive
    
    if blackHoleActive then
        local char = Player.Character
        if not char then return end
        
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end
        
        local Folder = Instance.new("Folder")
        Folder.Name = "BlackHole"
        Folder.Parent = Workspace
        
        local Part = Instance.new("Part", Folder)
        Part.Anchored = true
        Part.CanCollide = false
        Part.Transparency = 1
        Part.Size = Vector3.new(100, 100, 100)
        
        Attachment1 = Instance.new("Attachment", Part)
        
        if not getgenv().Network then
            getgenv().Network = {
                BaseParts = {},
                Velocity = Vector3.new(999999, 999999, 999999)
            }
            
            Network.RetainPart = function(Part)
                if typeof(Part) == "Instance" and Part:IsA("BasePart") and Part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
                    table.insert(Network.BaseParts, Part)
                    Part.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
                    Part.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
            
            local function EnablePartControl()
                Player.ReplicationFocus = Workspace
                RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    sethiddenproperty(Player, "SimulationRadius", math.huge)
                    for _, Part in pairs(Network.BaseParts) do
                        if Part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
                            Part.Velocity = Network.Velocity
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            
            EnablePartControl()
        end
        
        local function ForcePart(v)
            if v:IsDescendantOf(char) then return end
            if v:IsA("BasePart") and not v.Anchored then
                if v.Parent and v.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then return end
                if v.Name == "Handle" then return end
                
                for _, x in next, v:GetChildren() do
                    if x:IsA("BodyAngularVelocity") or x:IsA("BodyForce") or x:IsA("BodyGyro") or 
                       x:IsA("BodyPosition") or x:IsA("BodyThrust") or x:IsA("BodyVelocity") or 
                       x:IsA("RocketPropulsion") or x:IsA("Torque") or x:IsA("AlignPosition") then
                        x:Destroy()
                    end
                end
                
                for _, att in pairs(v:GetChildren()) do
                    if att:IsA("Attachment") then att:Destroy() end
                end
                
                v.CanCollide = false
                
                local Torque = Instance.new("Torque", v)
                Torque.Torque = Vector3.new(Settings.BlackHolePower, Settings.BlackHolePower, Settings.BlackHolePower)
                
                local AlignPosition = Instance.new("AlignPosition", v)
                local Attachment2 = Instance.new("Attachment", v)
                
                Torque.Attachment0 = Attachment2
                AlignPosition.MaxForce = 9e18
                AlignPosition.MaxVelocity = 9e9
                AlignPosition.Responsiveness = 999999
                AlignPosition.Attachment0 = Attachment2
                AlignPosition.Attachment1 = Attachment1
            end
        end
        
        for _, v in next, Workspace:GetDescendants() do
            ForcePart(v)
        end
        
        Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(v)

local function startFling()
    flingActive = true

        while flingActive do
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

                c = Player.Character
                hrp = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                    vel = hrp.Velocity
                    hrp.Velocity = vel * Settings.FlingPower + Vector3.new(0, Settings.FlingPower, 0)
                    RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
                    if c and c.Parent and hrp and hrp.Parent then

                    end
                    RunService.Stepped:Wait()
                    if c and c.Parent and hrp and hrp.Parent then
                        hrp.Velocity = vel + Vector3.new(0, movel, 0)
                        movel = movel * -1
                    end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not Settings.FlyEnabled then return end
    
    local char = Player.Character
    if not char then return end
    
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end
    
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end
    
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end
    
    -- เช็คว่านั่งอยู่หรือไม่
    if hum.Sit then
        local moveDir = hum.MoveDirection
        if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then 
            IsFlying = true 
        end
        
        if IsFlying then
            -- หยุด Animation นั่ง
            for _, track in pairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                if track.Name:lower():find("sit") or track.Animation.AnimationId:lower():find("sit") then
                    track:Stop(0.1)
                end
            end
            
            bv.Parent = hrp
            bg.Parent = hrp
            bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
            bg.CFrame = cam.CFrame
            bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
            
            local velocity = Vector3.zero
            if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
                local camLook = cam.CFrame.LookVector
                local camRight = cam.CFrame.RightVector
                velocity = (camLook * moveDir:Dot(camLook) + camRight * moveDir:Dot(camRight)).Unit * Settings.FlySpeed
            end
            
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) or hum.Jump then 
                velocity = velocity + Vector3.new(0, Settings.FlySpeed, 0) 
            end
            
            bv.Velocity = velocity
        end
    else
        IsFlying = false
        bv.Parent = nil
        bg.Parent = nil
    end
end)

local ESPObjects = {}

local function RemoveESP(plr)
    local esp = ESPObjects[plr]
    if not esp then return end

    if esp.Tracer then
        esp.Tracer.Visible = false
        esp.Tracer:Remove()
    end

    if esp.Box then
        esp.Box.Visible = false
        esp.Box:Remove()
    end

    if esp.Highlight then
        esp.Highlight:Destroy()
    end

    if esp.Billboard then
        esp.Billboard:Destroy()
    end

    ESPObjects[plr] = nil
end

local function CreateESP(plr)
    if plr == Player then return end

    local function Setup(character)
        RemoveESP(plr)

        local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
        if not hrp then return end

        local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
        highlight.FillTransparency = 1
        highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
        highlight.OutlineColor = Settings.ESPColor
        highlight.Enabled = false
        highlight.Parent = character

        local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 30)
        billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
        billboard.Enabled = false
        billboard.Parent = hrp

        local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        label.TextSize = 14
        label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        label.TextColor3 = Settings.ESPColor
        label.Text = ""
        label.Parent = billboard

        local tracer = Drawing.new("Line")
        tracer.Visible = false
        tracer.Color = Settings.ESPColor
        tracer.Thickness = 1.5
        tracer.Transparency = 1
        tracer.ZIndex = 2

        local box = Drawing.new("Square")
        box.Visible = false
        box.Color = Settings.ESPColor
        box.Thickness = 2
        box.Filled = false
        box.Transparency = 0.5
        box.ZIndex = 1

        ESPObjects[plr] = {
            Highlight = highlight,
            Billboard = billboard,
            Label = label,
            Tracer = tracer,
            Box = box
        }
    end

    if plr.Character then
        Setup(plr.Character)
    end

    plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(Setup)
end

for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    CreateESP(plr)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(CreateESP)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(RemoveESP)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not Settings.ESPEnabled then
        for _, data in pairs(ESPObjects) do
            data.Tracer.Visible = false
            if data.Box then
                data.Box.Visible = false
            end
            data.Highlight.Enabled = false
            data.Billboard.Enabled = false
        end
        return
    end

    local myChar = Player.Character
    if not myChar then return end

    local myHRP = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myHRP then return end

    for plr, data in pairs(ESPObjects) do
        data.Tracer.Visible = false
        if data.Box then
            data.Box.Visible = false
        end
        data.Highlight.Enabled = false

        local char = plr.Character
        if not char then
            continue
        end

        local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if not hum or not hrp or hum.Health <= 0 then
            continue
        end

        local distance = math.floor((myHRP.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude)

        if Settings.BoxEnabled and data.Box then
            local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
            
            if onScreen then
                local sizeMultiplier = math.clamp(100 / (distance + 50), 0.5, 2)
                local boxWidth = 50 * sizeMultiplier
                local boxHeight = 80 * sizeMultiplier
                
                data.Box.Size = Vector2.new(boxWidth, boxHeight)
                data.Box.Position = Vector2.new(
                    pos.X - (boxWidth / 2),
                    pos.Y - (boxHeight / 2)
                )
                data.Box.Color = Settings.ESPColor
                data.Box.Visible = true
            end
        end

        if Settings.OutlineEnabled then
            data.Highlight.Enabled = true
            data.Highlight.OutlineColor = Settings.ESPColor
        end

        local txt = ""

        if Settings.NameEnabled then
            txt = plr.Name
        end

        if Settings.DistanceEnabled then
            if txt ~= "" then
                txt = txt .. " "
            end
            txt = txt .. "[" .. distance .. "m]"
        end

        data.Label.Text = txt
        data.Label.TextColor3 = Settings.ESPColor
        data.Billboard.Enabled = (Settings.NameEnabled or Settings.DistanceEnabled)

        if Settings.TracerEnabled then
            local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)

            if onScreen then
                data.Tracer.Visible = true
                data.Tracer.From = Vector2.new(
                    Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2,
                    0
                )
                data.Tracer.To = Vector2.new(
                    pos.X,
                    pos.Y
                )
                data.Tracer.Color = Settings.ESPColor
            end
        end
    end
end)

local function gradient(text, startColor, endColor)
    local result = ""
    for i = 1, #text do
        local t = (i - 1) / (#text - 1)
        local r = math.floor((startColor.R + (endColor.R - startColor.R) * t) * 255)
        local g = math.floor((startColor.G + (endColor.G - startColor.G) * t) * 255)
        local b = math.floor((startColor.B + (endColor.B - startColor.B) * t) * 255)
        result = result .. string.format('<font color="rgb(%d,%d,%d)">%s</font>', r, g, b, text:sub(i, i))

    return result
end

        Part.Anchored = true
        Part.CanCollide = false

            }
            
            Network.RetainPart = function(Part)
                if typeof(Part) == "Instance" and Part:IsA("BasePart") and Part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
                    table.insert(Network.BaseParts, Part)
                    Part.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
                    Part.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
            
            local function EnablePartControl()
                Player.ReplicationFocus = Workspace
                RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    sethiddenproperty(Player, "SimulationRadius", math.huge)
                    for _, Part in pairs(Network.BaseParts) do
                        if Part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
                            Part.Velocity = Network.Velocity
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            
            EnablePartControl()
        end
        
        local function ForcePart(v)
            if v:IsDescendantOf(char) then return end
            if v:IsA("BasePart") and not v.Anchored then
                if v.Parent and v.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then return end
                if v.Name == "Handle" then return end
                
                for _, x in next, v:GetChildren() do
                    if x:IsA("BodyAngularVelocity") or x:IsA("BodyForce") or x:IsA("BodyGyro") or 
                       x:IsA("BodyPosition") or x:IsA("BodyThrust") or x:IsA("BodyVelocity") or 
                       x:IsA("RocketPropulsion") or x:IsA("Torque") or x:IsA("AlignPosition") then
                        x:Destroy()
                    end
                end
                
                for _, att in pairs(v:GetChildren()) do
                    if att:IsA("Attachment") then att:Destroy() end
                end
                
                v.CanCollide = false
                
                local Torque = Instance.new("Torque", v)
                Torque.Torque = Vector3.new(Settings.BlackHolePower, Settings.BlackHolePower, Settings.BlackHolePower)
                
                local AlignPosition = Instance.new("AlignPosition", v)
                local Attachment2 = Instance.new("Attachment", v)
                
                Torque.Attachment0 = Attachment2
                AlignPosition.MaxForce = 9e18
                AlignPosition.MaxVelocity = 9e9
                AlignPosition.Responsiveness = 999999
                AlignPosition.Attachment0 = Attachment2
                AlignPosition.Attachment1 = Attachment1
            end
        end
        
        for _, v in next, Workspace:GetDescendants() do
            ForcePart(v)
        end
        
        Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(v)
            if blackHoleActive then
                task.wait(0.05)
                ForcePart(v)
            end
        end)
        
        blackHoleConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

            if not hrp or not Attachment1 then return end
            
            Attachment1.WorldCFrame = hrp.CFrame
        end)
    else
        if blackHoleConnection then
            blackHoleConnection:Disconnect()
            blackHoleConnection = nil
        end
        
        if Attachment1 then
            local parent = Attachment1.Parent
            if parent and parent.Parent then
                parent.Parent:Destroy()
            end
            Attachment1 = nil
        end
    end
end

        local moveDir = hum.MoveDirection
        if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then 
            IsFlying = true 
        end
        
        if IsFlying then
            -- หยุด Animation นั่ง
            for _, track in pairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                if track.Name:lower():find("sit") or track.Animation.AnimationId:lower():find("sit") then
                    track:Stop(0.1)
                end
            end
            
            bv.Parent = hrp
            bg.Parent = hrp
            bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
            bg.CFrame = cam.CFrame
            bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
            
            local velocity = Vector3.zero
            if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
                local camLook = cam.CFrame.LookVector
                local camRight = cam.CFrame.RightVector
                velocity = (camLook * moveDir:Dot(camLook) + camRight * moveDir:Dot(camRight)).Unit * Settings.FlySpeed
            end
            
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) or hum.Jump then 
                velocity = velocity + Vector3.new(0, Settings.FlySpeed, 0) 
            end
            
            bv.Velocity = velocity
        end
    else
        IsFlying = false
        bv.Parent = nil
        bg.Parent = nil
    end
end)

local ESPObjects = {}

local function RemoveESP(plr)
    local esp = ESPObjects[plr]
    if not esp then return end

    if esp.Tracer then
        esp.Tracer.Visible = false
        esp.Tracer:Remove()
    end

    if esp.Box then
        esp.Box.Visible = false
        esp.Box:Remove()
    end

    if esp.Highlight then
        esp.Highlight:Destroy()
    end

    if esp.Billboard then
        esp.Billboard:Destroy()
    end

    ESPObjects[plr] = nil
end

local function CreateESP(plr)
    if plr == Player then return end

    local function Setup(character)
        RemoveESP(plr)

        local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
        if not hrp then return end

        local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
        highlight.FillTransparency = 1
        highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
        highlight.OutlineColor = Settings.ESPColor
        highlight.Enabled = false
        highlight.Parent = character

        local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 30)
        billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
        billboard.Enabled = false
        billboard.Parent = hrp

        local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        label.TextSize = 14
        label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        label.TextColor3 = Settings.ESPColor
        label.Text = ""
        label.Parent = billboard

        local tracer = Drawing.new("Line")
        tracer.Visible = false
        tracer.Color = Settings.ESPColor
        tracer.Thickness = 1.5
        tracer.Transparency = 1
        tracer.ZIndex = 2

        local box = Drawing.new("Square")
        box.Visible = false
        box.Color = Settings.ESPColor
        box.Thickness = 2
        box.Filled = false
        box.Transparency = 0.5
        box.ZIndex = 1

        ESPObjects[plr] = {
            Highlight = highlight,
            Billboard = billboard,
            Label = label,
            Tracer = tracer,
            Box = box
        }
    end

    if plr.Character then
        Setup(plr.Character)
    end

    plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(Setup)
end

for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    CreateESP(plr)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(CreateESP)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(RemoveESP)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not Settings.ESPEnabled then
        for _, data in pairs(ESPObjects) do
            data.Tracer.Visible = false
            if data.Box then
                data.Box.Visible = false
            end
            data.Highlight.Enabled = false
            data.Billboard.Enabled = false
        end
        return
    end

    local myChar = Player.Character
    if not myChar then return end

    local myHRP = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myHRP then return end

    for plr, data in pairs(ESPObjects) do
        data.Tracer.Visible = false
        if data.Box then
            data.Box.Visible = false
        end
        data.Highlight.Enabled = false

        local char = plr.Character
        if not char then
            continue
        end

        local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if not hum or not hrp or hum.Health <= 0 then
            continue
        end

        local distance = math.floor((myHRP.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude)

        if Settings.BoxEnabled and data.Box then
            local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
            
            if onScreen then
                local sizeMultiplier = math.clamp(100 / (distance + 50), 0.5, 2)
                local boxWidth = 50 * sizeMultiplier
                local boxHeight = 80 * sizeMultiplier
                
                data.Box.Size = Vector2.new(boxWidth, boxHeight)
                data.Box.Position = Vector2.new(
                    pos.X - (boxWidth / 2),
                    pos.Y - (boxHeight / 2)
                )
                data.Box.Color = Settings.ESPColor
                data.Box.Visible = true
            end
        end

        if Settings.OutlineEnabled then
            data.Highlight.Enabled = true
            data.Highlight.OutlineColor = Settings.ESPColor
        end

        local txt = ""

        if Settings.NameEnabled then
            txt = plr.Name
        end

        if Settings.DistanceEnabled then
            if txt ~= "" then
                txt = txt .. " "
            end
            txt = txt .. "[" .. distance .. "m]"
        end

        data.Label.Text = txt
        data.Label.TextColor3 = Settings.ESPColor
        data.Billboard.Enabled = (Settings.NameEnabled or Settings.DistanceEnabled)

        if Settings.TracerEnabled then
            local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)

            if onScreen then
                data.Tracer.Visible = true
                data.Tracer.From = Vector2.new(
                    Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2,
                    0
                )
                data.Tracer.To = Vector2.new(
                    pos.X,
                    pos.Y
                )
                data.Tracer.Color = Settings.ESPColor
            end
        end
    end
end)
